recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-12952 clarification with a narrow wording alignment and does not require additional work unless the work group later wants to revisit the broader DSS knowledge-assets terminology across resources.
issue_request: FHIR-12952 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 clarification request asking that ActivityDefinition element definitions stop referring ambiguously to assets when they meant the specific activity definition resource.
initial_application: The issue was applied at SVN 12593, now git commit febf675fdf9c598ca6efe1dcb2976ac9ad268f52, which changed old ActivityDefinition spreadsheet wording for usage, jurisdiction requirements, contributor, relatedArtifact requirements, and library from asset/assets to activity definition language. That application left the ActivityDefinition.version note saying a version is required for non-experimental active assets.
additional_context: ActivityDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Later source refactors moved the artifact into structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml, and the old contributor element was replaced by author/editor/reviewer/endorser. Peer knowledge-artifact resources use active artifacts in the same version note; the broader knowledge assets DSS phrase remains in peer resources and was left unchanged. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later contrary decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml and the matching checked-in source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition.svg title from active assets to active artifacts.
source_changes: source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml: updated ActivityDefinition.version definition from non-experimental active assets to non-experimental active artifacts.
source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition.svg: synchronized the ActivityDefinition.version diagram title with the StructureDefinition wording.
